description: This PHP class 'AccessEmployeeFileController' is part of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It handles requests to access employee data in JSON format, controlling access based on user permissions, retrieving employee information via a maintenance service, and formatting responses with appropriate headers.

classes.name: AccessEmployeeFileController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling requests to access employee data in JSON format, ensuring user permissions, and formatting the response accordingly.

methods.name: getDownloadFormat
methods.description: Returns an instance of JsonDownloadFormat, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getMaintenanceService
methods.description: Returns an instance of MaintenanceService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes an incoming request, verifies user permission, retrieves employee data, and prepares a JSON response with appropriate headers.
